helpMeld: m <i,j,k>                put down hand cards i, j and k as a meld
helpLayOff: o <i> <m>                add hand card i to meld m
helpDesmoche: x <from> <i> <to>        move card i of meld from into meld to
ruleLine: melding exactly ten cards (nine dealt plus one drawn) takes the pot / poker hand rankings play no part
promptDraw: ds to draw from the stock / dd to take the discard
promptAct: m <i,j,k> to meld / o <i> <m> to lay off / x <from> <i> <to> to rearrange / d <i> to discard
roundWinner: {{name}} melds ten and takes the pot
roundNoWinner: The stock ran out with nobody down to ten. The pot of {{pot}} carries over
helpExampleDraw: dd                       take the top discard instead of drawing
promptActLayoffNote: Note: laying off onto another player's meld gives them the card — it does not count toward your 10
